svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The four procedures of the L24 Lab, each with the trace to expect against the uniform pattern. A, Steps 6 to 10: the eight computed weights put a notch at plus 22.5 degrees. B, Steps 11 to 15: Beam 1 Phase at 180 degrees puts a null at boresight with a peak on each side. C, Steps 16 to 22: MVDR puts its one null on an interferer at plus 20 degrees. D, Steps 23 to 27: the sum and delta beams together, the delta zero on boresight.
